affirmative_capability.rule: Before physical first VALID, L<=r+Q bounds the still-unwritten physical child debt at any real source starvation by Q; true progress is the decreasing measure for successful recourse.
affirmative_capability.scope: This is a conditional service-work capability under the complete return-envelope WRITE certificate and before-every-owner child interface. It is not a universal wallclock bound or a proof of novelty.
affirmative_capability.normal_resident_limit: With the already accepted peer's 3 real payload words occupying half the common six slots until its intent30, a fully resident A child cannot contain six stored words. For an all-resident ordinary policy, every physical A AW before30 has length<=3, so N12 completion by18 requires at least four physical A AW. Reserved empty/future slots are not real payload.
affirmative_capability.qualification: That lower bound applies to all-resident commitments, not to the allowed adaptive ordinary streaming control. A streaming control can choose AW9 without all nine words ready. Normal A18/AW2 versus C&F A22/AW4 alone therefore does not exclude one such ordinary policy.

concrete_ordinary_counterpolicy.authorship: A concrete ordinary comparison designed in this critical review, not a claim that this exact heuristic is a published implementation.
concrete_ordinary_counterpolicy.name: Resident startup prefix, then source-history adaptive streaming
concrete_ordinary_counterpolicy.inputs: Only actual accepted R handshakes, FIFO contents, observed elapsed cycles since R, fixed N12, peer requests and the common validated parent grant. No future supply oracle or peeking unaccepted held R is required.
policy: Initially wait for three actual A words, then issue one fully resident length3 AW. Preserve the same original source AR12.
Track whether the source has experienced an observed idle interval of at least8 cycles. This is an already elapsed condition, not a forecast of future DDR service.
When the initial length3 physical B has settled and there has been no long idle, issue one streaming AW for the remaining9 once the first remaining word is ready.

If a long idle was observed before the next word arrives, use one short streaming length3 AW on that first resumed word instead. After its physical B settles, obtain three actual words and issue a streaming AW for the remaining6.

Use the same parent grant, physical range derivation, true child LAST, source retention, pooled payload, same-ID ordering and single descriptor reuse after the old physical B. Never null-pad, cancel held VALID or reread payload.
concrete_ordinary_counterpolicy.important_limit: The policy deliberately does not guarantee <=Q uncovered debt for every possible future inside its length9/6 streaming AW. It is nevertheless a legal strong ordinary control for the two selected continuations.

scope_verdict.selected_points: The original two histories establish two chosen-control comparisons, not absence of a matching adaptive ordinary streaming policy. The concrete policy above matches or improves both requested cost/completion points.
scope_verdict.retained_claim: Keep the L<=r+Q bounded uncovered-physical-debt capability as a design property. To establish an exclusive online contribution, a finite scenario must challenge a new unexpected gap inside an ordinary already committed streaming AW, charge all jobs and permissions, and compare a complete adaptive ordinary policy.
scope_verdict.not_claimed: No proof that the candidate is optimal, no proof that all ordinary controls fail, no proof that the heuristic is prior published work, and no new performance/novelty acceptance from this hand clarification.
scope_verdict.if_because: Because a concrete future-blind ordinary matches the two existing points, those points cannot prove exclusive performance innovation. If an independently required bounded-debt guarantee yields a complete resource/cost point that strong ordinary controls cannot match and accurate prior scope excludes the same success continuation, the complete architecture can retain a narrow contribution.

post_second_commit_surprise_branch.kind: Parent-requested exact conditional hand branch; preserves every earlier example and result. No new benchmark/model execution.
post_second_commit_surprise_branch.matched_observed_prefix: A descriptor/source AR12 and complete parent authorization are unchanged. Both continuations have actual A R0/1/2 at0/1/2, A R3/4 at5/6, and A R5 at7. The ordinary initial resident3 AW3/W4..6/B7 and its observed R-acceptance gaps are identical through its second AW9 firstVALID/acceptance at7. post_second_commit_surprise_branch.new_future: Only later service changes: A6..11 are eligible100..105 instead of the continuous service. The already fully resident and authorized independent B intent becomes eligible10, strictly after ordinary second commitment7. This later information cannot legally change the ordinary held/accepted AW9.
post_second_commit_surprise_branch.ordinary_true_debt: At AW9 commitment7, its start-of-cycle actual resident prefix is only A3/A4 (r2); A5 is accepted during7. It writes these three real words at8/9/10. From cycle11 it owes six true words in that same physical burst, q6>Q3. There is no payload for the next real W until A6 returns100. Without adding successful recourse or another physical lane it cannot shorten the AW, change held VALID, or release its owner for B.
post_second_commit_surprise_branch.candidate_action: The candidate's first bounded child AW6 at3 already reaches real physical LAST9, with B10. It has r0 for a new child and therefore has no new physical A claim. B can issue AW10 and real W11..13/ACK14 while the retained source AR still waits. No synthetic W is needed in this particular branch.
post_second_commit_surprise_branch.scope_verdict: Against this exact adaptive ordinary counterpart, L<=r+Q plus conditional recourse gives a uniform physical-debt capability that the counterpart lacks: the latter can match the two earlier chosen cost points yet expose q6 on a later surprise. This does not prove independent novelty, superiority over every ordinary policy, or total ACK dominance. An ordinary that gives up streaming9 for smaller/resident commitments, or uses a correct success-replay action, must be compared at its actual whole-job costs.
post_second_commit_surprise_branch.card_limitation: The earlier normal/gap comparisons remain unchanged as observations against their named controls. The clarification supersedes any interpretation that those two comparisons alone prove absence of one adaptive matching control. The retained claim is the conditional commitment-debt bound and its complete resource/authorization contract.
